currentParagraphText: “You came here with the hopes of creating a bond between the vampire families and your clan, correct? Allow me to make clear now you have succeeded in that,” she said, looking over to Fairleigh. “Have a delegation ready for when the new universe begins to open up. I will also discuss with the other True Ancestors to make sure the ones going can place a teleportation circle, allowing those of your clan to visit us here at the Order, too.”
